mechanism.claim: Deribit implied volatility expanding while Binance BVOL contracts marks offshore options-led risk discovery; when a moderate-to-large first-half BTC move is opposed by a second-half move of at least half its magnitude, the absorbing direction should relay for six hours
mechanism.why_distinct: DEPAR fixes the asymmetric volatility state DVOL expansion/BVOL contraction and requires partial opposite flow without an hourly-open reclaim; CVDAR accepted either volatility polarity and required a full reclaim
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: the asymmetric options venue state plus exact half-hour absorption path is absent from Gross9

clock.decision: T after a completed UTC hour
clock.volatility: normalized DVOL body strictly positive and normalized BVOL body strictly negative
clock.price_source: 60 exact BTCUSDT 1m bars in [T-1h,T), split at exact minute 30
clock.first_half_move: nonzero absolute first-half return >= strictly-prior 720h q60 with 672 observations
clock.partial_absorption: second-half return has the opposite nonzero sign and absolute magnitude >= one half of first-half absolute return; no hourly-open reclaim requirement
clock.funding: not a signal input; opened only for later exact PnL accounting
clock.trigger: false-to-true onset, prior hour source-valid and consecutive
clock.entry: exact BTCUSDT T+5m open, all features available by T
clock.reservation: global half-open, exit first on equal open

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding marks, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.intrahour_price: reuse hash-bound OLIAH completed-hour intrahour snapshot
source_plan.execution_price: sealed until source-support and Gross9 novelty pass
